SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM v_activities WHERE instr(flags, 'QC5') > 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_exact_measurements, COUNT(pic50) AS n_with_pic50, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pic50) AS median_pic50, SUM(CASE WHEN flags IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(flags) NOT IN ('', '[]', '{}', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_flagged FROM v_activities WHERE relation = '='

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_exact_measurements, COUNT(pic50) AS n_with_pic50, AVG(CASE WHEN rn BETWEEN n_with_pic50 / 2.0 AND n_with_pic50 / 2.0 + 1 THEN pic50 END) AS median_pic50, SUM(CASE WHEN flags IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(flags) NOT IN ('', '[]', '{}', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_flagged FROM (SELECT pic50, flags, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN pic50 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, pic50) AS rn, COUNT(pic50) OVER () AS n_with_pic50 FROM v_activities WHERE relation = '=') AS exact_measurements

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pic50) AS median_pic50, COUNT(*) AS n_exact_rows, COUNT(pic50) AS n_nonnull_pic50, SUM(CASE WHEN flags IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(flags) NOT IN ('', '[]', '{}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_flagged_rows FROM v_activities WHERE relation = '=' AND snapshot = '2026-11-15.1'

SELECT AVG(pic50) AS median_pic50, MAX(n) AS n_measurements, MAX(n_flagged) AS n_flagged FROM (SELECT pic50, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pic50) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN flags IS NOT NULL AND flags NOT IN ('', '[]', '{}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS n_flagged FROM v_activities WHERE relation = '=' AND pic50 IS NOT NULL AND snapshot = '2026-11-15.1') AS ranked WHERE rn >= n / 2.0 AND rn <= n / 2.0 + 1

SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pic50) AS median_pic50, COUNT(*) AS n_exact_measurements, COUNT(pic50) AS n_nonnull_pic50, COUNT(CASE WHEN flags IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(flags) NOT IN ('', '[]', '{}', 'null') THEN 1 END) AS n_flagged_measurements FROM v_activities WHERE relation = '=' AND snapshot = '2026-11-15.1'

SELECT AVG(pic50) AS median_pic50, MAX(n) AS n_nonnull_pic50, MAX(n_flagged) AS n_flagged_measurements FROM (SELECT pic50, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pic50) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN flags IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(flags) NOT IN ('', '[]', '{}', 'null') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER () AS n_flagged FROM v_activities WHERE relation = '=' AND pic50 IS NOT NULL AND snapshot = '2026-11-15.1') AS ranked WHERE rn IN ((n + 1) / 2, (n + 2) / 2)
SELECT relation, COUNT(*) AS row_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS total_rows FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1' GROUP BY relation ORDER BY row_count DESC, relation

WITH populations AS (SELECT 'all rows' AS population, pic50 FROM v_activities UNION ALL SELECT 'exact (=) rows' AS population, pic50 FROM v_activities WHERE relation = '='), ranked AS (SELECT population, pic50, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY population ORDER BY pic50) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY population) AS n FROM populations WHERE pic50 IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.population, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(p.pic50) AS n_nonnull_pic50, (SELECT AVG(r.pic50) FROM ranked r WHERE r.population = p.population AND r.rn BETWEEN r.n / 2.0 AND r.n / 2.0 + 1) AS median_pic50 FROM populations p GROUP BY p.population ORDER BY p.population

SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_rows, COUNT(pic50) AS all_nonnull_pic50, (SELECT AVG(pic50) FROM (SELECT pic50, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pic50) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM v_activities WHERE pic50 IS NOT NULL) AS ranked_all WHERE rn BETWEEN n / 2.0 AND n / 2.0 + 1) AS all_median_pic50, SUM(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_rows, (SELECT AVG(pic50) FROM (SELECT pic50, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pic50) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n FROM v_activities WHERE relation = '=' AND pic50 IS NOT NULL) AS ranked_exact WHERE rn BETWEEN n / 2.0 AND n / 2.0 + 1) AS exact_median_pic50 FROM v_activities

WITH p AS (SELECT 'all' AS population, pic50 FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1' UNION ALL SELECT 'exact' AS population, pic50 FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1' AND relation = '='), r AS (SELECT population, pic50, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY population ORDER BY pic50) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY population) AS n FROM p WHERE pic50 IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.population, COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(p.pic50) AS rows_with_pic50, (SELECT AVG(r.pic50) FROM r WHERE r.population = p.population AND r.rn BETWEEN r.n / 2.0 AND r.n / 2.0 + 1) AS median_pic50 FROM p GROUP BY p.population ORDER BY p.population

SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_with_pic50, AVG(CASE WHEN rn_all BETWEEN n_all / 2.0 AND n_all / 2.0 + 1 THEN pic50 END) AS median_all, SUM(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_rows_with_pic50, AVG(CASE WHEN relation = '=' AND rn_relation BETWEEN n_relation / 2.0 AND n_relation / 2.0 + 1 THEN pic50 END) AS median_exact FROM (SELECT pic50, relation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pic50) AS rn_all, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n_all, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY relation ORDER BY pic50) AS rn_relation, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY relation) AS n_relation FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1' AND pic50 IS NOT NULL) AS ranked

WITH populations AS (SELECT 'all_rows' AS population, pic50 FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1' UNION ALL SELECT 'exact_rows' AS population, pic50 FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1' AND relation = '='), totals AS (SELECT population, COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(pic50) AS rows_with_pic50 FROM populations GROUP BY population), ranked AS (SELECT population, pic50, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY population ORDER BY pic50) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY population) AS n FROM populations WHERE pic50 IS NOT NULL), medians AS (SELECT population, AVG(pic50) AS median_pic50 FROM ranked WHERE 2 * rn BETWEEN n AND n + 2 GROUP BY population), results AS (SELECT t.population, t.total_rows, t.rows_with_pic50, m.median_pic50 FROM totals t LEFT JOIN medians m ON t.population = m.population) SELECT population, total_rows, rows_with_pic50, median_pic50, median_pic50 - MAX(CASE WHEN population = 'all_rows' THEN median_pic50 END) OVER () AS change_from_all_rows FROM results ORDER BY population;

SELECT s.*, s.exact_median_pic50 - s.all_median_pic50 AS change_exact_minus_all FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_rows, COUNT(pic50) AS all_rows_with_pic50, AVG(CASE WHEN pic50 IS NOT NULL AND 2 * rn_all BETWEEN n_all AND n_all + 2 THEN pic50 END) AS all_median_pic50, SUM(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN relation = '=' AND pic50 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exact_rows_with_pic50, AVG(CASE WHEN relation = '=' AND pic50 IS NOT NULL AND 2 * rn_relation BETWEEN n_relation AND n_relation + 2 THEN pic50 END) AS exact_median_pic50 FROM (SELECT pic50, relation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CASE WHEN pic50 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, pic50) AS rn_all, COUNT(pic50) OVER () AS n_all, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY relation ORDER BY CASE WHEN pic50 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, pic50) AS rn_relation, COUNT(pic50) OVER (PARTITION BY relation) AS n_relation FROM v_activities WHERE snapshot = '2026-11-15.1') r) s;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS compounds_without_exact, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n_censored > 0 AND n_unknown = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS censored_only, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n_censored = 0 AND n_unknown > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknown_only, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN n_censored > 0 AND n_unknown > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS censored_and_unknown FROM (SELECT inchikey, SUM(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_exact, SUM(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_censored, SUM(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_unknown FROM v_activities GROUP BY inchikey) AS compounds WHERE n_exact = 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_compounds_no_exact, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_censored = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n_with_censored, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_unknown = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n_with_unknown, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_flagged = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS n_with_flagged_rows FROM (SELECT inchikey, MAX(CASE WHEN relation = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_exact, MAX(CASE WHEN relation IN ('<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_censored, MAX(CASE WHEN relation IS NULL OR relation NOT IN ('=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_unknown, MAX(CASE WHEN flags IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(flags) NOT IN ('', '[]', '{}') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_flagged FROM v_activities GROUP BY inchikey) AS compound_relations WHERE has_exact = 0
